skill.summary: Create comprehensive, personalized travel itineraries with day-by-day plans, budget breakdowns, packing lists, and practical tips for any destination.

latestVersion.changelog:
Major simplification and reorientation: This version removes detailed file references and onboarding instructions, focusing the skill on personalized, end-to-end travel itinerary creation.

- Removed legacy markdown files and internal architecture details.
- Skill now centers on generating comprehensive, customizable travel plans with accommodations, budgets, packing lists, and local insights.
- Updated best practices, output format, and rules for realistic, personalized itineraries.
- Expanded practical guidance and traveler type customization.
- Added specific guidelines for web, places, and map searches to support up-to-date recommendations.
